tagline: Quality Garments for the Entire Family
landmark: Near Clock Tower, Opposite Central Bank
delivery_terms: Same-day delivery for orders placed before 3:00 PM; next-day delivery for later orders. Free delivery on orders above ₹999. Flat ₹50 delivery charge for orders under ₹999.
payment_methods: UPI / QR Code (Google Pay, PhonePe, Paytm)
return_policy_summary: Exchanges allowed within 3 days of purchase or delivery. Direct cash refunds are not offered; store credit or size/color replacement is provided. Garments must have original tags intact, be unworn, unwashed, and accompanied by the original receipt or order ID.
exchange_policy_summary: Size and color exchanges can be initiated online through the order tracking portal or in-store within 3 days. Subject to stock availability.
alteration_summary: Complimentary length and waist alterations available for garments purchased at Rainbow Ready Mades, with a 24-48 hour turnaround time.
source: Rainbow Ready Mades Store Manager & Physical Storefront Records
